verdict.rationale: Fidelity has a documented native Gusto integration that syncs hiring/onboarding and equity data and can auto-grant equity from offer-letter promises, directly matching the ops-sync use case. However, evidence only covers Gusto — no mention of Rippling or other payroll/HRIS systems, and no detail on termination-event syncing specifically. Missing for 10: Rippling/other HRIS integration evidence, explicit termination-triggered equity updates, independent corroboration of the Gusto sync working in practice.
